subject: Engage Lift-Off: trial orbits & ownership plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@odinhealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@odinhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engage Lift-Off: trial orbits & ownership plan

Thanks for a constructive discovery call this morning — appreciated the clarity on the evaluation goals. Below is a concise post-call recap, proposed POC plan, and clear owner-level asks to get us to kick-off next week. Please review and confirm edits or blockers so we can lock schedule.

Key evaluation goals (what success looks like for Odin):
- Latency: median inference latency for typical queries < 200ms (95th < 500ms)
- Throughput: sustain 50 qps for peak batch tests with 5–10 token responses
- Functionality: ability to call internal tool endpoints via function-calling flow and preserve structured outputs
- Data controls: logs and KV cache not persisted outside your VPC during Private trial runs
- Usability: integration with your SSO + reportable audit logs for each session

Proposed trial scope (2 weeks):
Week 0 (pre-kickoff, immediate): SSO access + sample dataset delivery; quick intake of security questionnaire items you flagged
Week 1 (kickoff -> run tests): baseline runs (latency/throughput), tool-calling smoke tests, and QA on structured outputs
Week 2 (stress & handoff): scale tests, regression checks against your prompt set, and handover to your platform team

Owners and asks (please confirm):
- Odin: Jordan Lee — provide sample dataset (anonymized CSV), SSO admin contact, and confirm VM/network whitelists by 2026-09-10
- Redwood: Tessa Morgan — POC kickoff facilitation, run baseline tests, and consolidate results
- Redwood: Ben Carter — responsible for runtime tuning / quantization suggestions and dedicated-capacity sizing
- Redwood: Monica Patel — security questionnaire follow-through and evidence collection (SOC2 extracts, audit logs)

Immediate requests from Redwood (action items):
1) Jordan: share a 10–20k-row anonymized sample and a small prompt bank by 2026-09-10 (see sample_ingest_checklist.xlsx attached)
2) Priya: confirm kickoff slot (I proposed Thu 2026-09-10 10:00am PT) or suggest alternatives
3) Odin IT: confirm whether Private trial (VPC) is required or a hosted sandbox is acceptable for initial runs

Attachments: Odin_POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf (success criteria & eval rubric), sample_ingest_checklist.xlsx

Goal: lock kickoff + sample data by EOD Friday so we can reserve dedicated nodes and get SSO wired over the weekend.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@odinhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engage Lift-Off: trial orbits & ownership plan

Thanks Tessa — this looks good and mirrors our internal priorities. Quick confirmations and minor edits below: 
- We can provide a 12k-row anonymized CSV and the prompt bank by 2026-09-10 EOD. I’ll drop it in the Drive link you sent.
- Kickoff: Thu 2026-09-10 10:00am PT works for Jordan and Priya. Can we include a short 15-min segment in the kickoff for Odin platform to outline networking constraints?
- Security: we do want VPC isolation for the main runs; however, if SSO + scoped sandbox can be turned up faster, we’re OK doing an initial smoke-run on hosted sandbox and then switch to VPC for scale tests.

Also: Legal will want an explicit data retention note — can you confirm that Redwood will not persist raw inputs outside the trial and will share deletion receipts after closure?

Best,
Jordan

On the retention ask: Redwood will provide deletion receipts and a scoped retention policy for trial artifacts; Monica, can you own the evidence pack for Legal (SOC2 snippets + deletion receipts)? I’ll include the sizing and cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted.

— Ben
